title: Add Telemprompit teleprompter and shared PrompterKit package (#62)
paragraphs: * Add Telemprompit teleprompter and shared PrompterKit package

Telemprompit is a native macOS teleprompter that opens on the Elgato Prompter (or the main screen when it is off), parses pasted notes and Notion bullet lists, and steps through them line by line or auto-scrolls. It has a drag handle, resize grip, persisted settings, mirroring, global clicker keys, and telemprompit:// URL commands.
The prompter display lookup and DisplayLink switch move from Taskbar into tools/lib/PrompterKit so Taskbar, Video HQ and Telemprompit share them.
* Telemprompit: note how to re-render the header

- Keep the reader on the same line when edits insert or remove lines above it
- Keep tag-shaped text inside code spans; match fence lengths
- Build the settings window once so the script editor keeps undo and caret
- Publish the current display to settings, validate menu items
- Clamp side margins to the window width; show full code blocks
- kill.sh waits for exit; launcher refuses to reuse a dying instance
- Stable signing requirement whenever the identity is ad hoc
- PrompterKit: singleton-only DisplayLink controller; Video HQ uses prompterScreen()
* Telemprompit: say whether the prompter is connected when the window is elsewhere
